measurement: X/Y motion module model, actual stroke, screw lead, motor variant
verification: Measure one full screw revolution against carriage travel; record real bottom slots, carriage face and endpoint envelopes. Update interface adapters against actual modules.

measurement: Delivered replacement Z geometry, spindle/collet datums and longest retained tool
design_basis: 200mm redesigned Z; nominal spindle reference970..1170 with10mm axial setup rise
verification: Record actual collet/nut and tool-tip datums, permitted clamp gripping region, motor/brake/retention and thread depths. Verify the15..50mm loaded-tool and26.35mm below-magazine-base limits against actual tools; these use different reference planes.

measurement: Guide rail/block model, fixing positions, straightness and parallelism
design_basis: HGR20 design seats; 0.05mm/1000mm nominal alignment target
verification: Record every physical rail hole and screw stack. Verify seat straightness under final torque and rail parallelism over travel; no invented fixed rail pitch.

measurement: Actual 4080 die, section properties, slot/core geometry, allowable joints
verification: Obtain supplier section drawing and permitted slot-nut/bolt preloads. Confirm all used faces, nut fit, core taps and screw bottoming in the selected profile.

measurement: Actual grade, thread engagement and tightening for each grip stack
design_basis: Use the frame, bed, motion, shields and ATC schedules together
verification: Check every thin plate seat, washer ligament, slot lip, screw tip and tool access. Nominal threaded CAD bores are not pilot-drill sizes.

measurement: Owned aluminum dimensions/alloy, plywood thickness/grain and glue process
design_basis: Two 304.8mm-square Al blanks; 12.7mm skins; qualified span E>=4000MPa
verification: Verify measured stocks and machining allowance. Cut rib joints to measured ply; face/prepare datum surfaces. Deep billets and unlisted plates have no ownership credit.

measurement: Exact magazine, spindle/nut compatibility, retained tools and reverse sequence
design_basis: See ATC-INTERFACE.md and actual reach report
verification: Verify the actual supplier magazine envelope and pocket/thread interfaces. Confirm spindle/VFD can execute the manufacturer tool-change cycle and the designed clearance applies to actual tools/fixtures.

measurement: Selected lock springs, cylinders, drive, belt, guides and sensors
design_basis: See the ATC fabrication schedule and mechanism report
verification: Select real springs meeting the stated rate, free length, compressed length and coil-bind limits. Confirm delivered actuator revision/fittings and drive/coupler/belt fits. Test withdrawal and return forces, positive pin engagement, gate retention, sensor gaps and loss-of-air behavior with the actual loaded rack.

measurement: Cutter identity/start type, isolated CNC start and torch grip/nozzle
verification: Use the real cutter manual and torch dimensions. Verify isolated start/arc sensing, EMI arrangement, touch-off/breakaway and direct work-return/bonding path. Do not infer start type from pilot arc.

measurement: Red tote measured usable volume and liquid/temperature load suitability
verification: Measure the actual tapered box/lid, approved liquid load and usable fill mark. Confirm removable return plumbing and empty-box service access with real lid/handles.

measurement: Framework/bed displacement and permanent joint movement
verification: Measure +/-X,+/-Y,+/-Z at representative and extreme head positions. Measure complete spindle-to-work compliance separately. Select any proof load only after checking actual hardware allowables.

measurement: Dry fixed/moving masses, CGs, all-foot contact and floor friction
design_basis: Rear and side stability per structure-screen.json
verification: Weigh assemblies, calculate actual support reactions in extreme poses, level all eight feet and verify overturning/sliding margins. Floor cabinet and receiver are not attached frame ballast.

measurement: Pan leak, gravity drain, overflow flow and real residual water
design_basis: Test at intended maximum fill flow
verification: Cold-test with real fittings/hoses and verify independent overflow reaches the vented receiver. Confirm lid air gaps and capacity, then empty/disconnect and trial the entire service path.

measurement: Protected wood, aluminum/guide, receiver and hose temperatures
design_basis: Use limits for the actual selected materials/components
verification: Clean dust/chips, perform representative plasma duty cycles with guards installed, and measure protected surfaces. Qualify wood storage during plasma only after this test.

measurement: Cassette mass, grips, human clearance and actual accessories
design_basis: 32 continuous CAD segment enclosures plus actual handling trial
verification: Power isolate, positively retain Z and remove complete tool module and cassette clamps. Trial with final shields, ATC parked, plumbing and actual weights. No outside-footprint parking is allocated.
